title: The effects of gender bias in word embeddings on depression prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Intrinsic evaluation using the Direct Bias metric (cosine similarity between a PCA-derived gender vector and depression-related synonyms) and extrinsic evaluation measuring the False Negative Rate Ratio (FNRR) between male and female groups on a downstream depression phenotype recognition task using original, pronoun-swapped, neutralized, and augmented clinical notes.
